title.narrative: THIRD PHASE INTERVENTIONS IN THE AQUACULTURE VALUE CHAIN IN NIASSA AND INHAMBANE

description.narrative: Chicoa Fish Farm will implement the project Third Phase Interventions in the Aquaculture Value Chain in Niassa and Inhambane provinces, covering a 11 month period from 1 November 2024 – 30 September 2025 to pursue the following outputs: 1) Technical assistance provided to newly identified small-scale fish farmers in both provinces; 2)Increased capacity of extension workers in the provinces to support aquaculture producers by providing technical assistance training; 3) Technical assistance and training provided to Ngauma Agricultural Institute to support tilapia aquaculture; 4) Stabilise and strengthen the value chain in Niassa through establishment of a cold-chain storage depot with an ice machine; 5)Establish a fish feed system in Mozambique to produce a minimum of 1,500 tonnes of fish feed per year for the sector and 6) Continue to support AMAQUA to contribute towards policy and strategic interventions in the Blue Economy in Mozambique, in particular in coordination with the Blue Economy Donor Working Group.
